oss.feature: sparse-sublist neighbour-list (mainlist + neilist + sublist; swap streaming stream1+stream2)
source: lists/base/mainlist_mod.f90:14-20 (pdf + neilist on fluid nodes only)
lists/base/sublist_mod.f90 (contiguous sub-range of the main list)

hypothesis.H1: The listLBM swap streaming (stream1+stream2) is equivalent to the FluidNodeTable push streaming on the same geometry (representation neutrality).
hypothesis.H2: The listLBM sparse-sublist neighbour-list reproduces the analytic plane-Poiseuille permeability k = H^2/12 within the owner 15% band.

metrics.table_equivalence: max|nodes_A - nodes_B| == 0 and max|neighbour_A - neighbour_B| == 0 (bit identical)

stopping_rules: Run 3 random porous geometries (seeds 1, 5, 13) for operator equivalence.
Run 1 plane-channel (H=16, ny=32) for physics, 2500 steps.
Stop early if any test fails the predeclared threshold.

confounders: collision and Guo forcing are shared verbatim between both arms

repetition_rationale: 3 seeds for operator equivalence (random porous geometry); 1 channel for physics (deterministic geometry). The operator equivalence is the strong claim (bit-identical), so 3 seeds suffice; the physics is a single deterministic anchor.

analysis.aggregation: max absolute relative deviation over all fluid nodes

safety.resource_limits: single CPU thread, < 30 s per test
